## PageRequest.pageSize property

The most items the page may hold: an integer from 1 to [PAGE_SIZE_LIMITS](./contracts.page_size_limits.md)<!-- -->.maximum. Anything else is rejected, never clamped.

**Signature:**

```typescript
readonly pageSize?: Integer;
```
